subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

The officer asked his subordinates to __keep him posted__ of the workplace developments.
solution:
The correct answer is: **keep sharing the latest information**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**keep him posted**" means to keep someone informed or updated about something. (किसी को किसी चीज़ के बारे में सूचित या अद्यतन रखना)

 
 
• **For example-** *As our project progresses, make sure to keep him posted with regular updates on the status and any significant changes.*
 
 
 
• The officer wants his subordinates to share the latest developments in the workplace with him.
 
• This idiom is commonly used in professional settings to indicate the need for communication and collaboration.
 
• Grammatically, "keep him posted" is a verb phrase that functions as a command or request.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**maintain secrecy**" is the opposite of the intended meaning of the idiom.
 
• "**send letters by post**" is a literal interpretation of the word "posted" but does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• "**not disturb him in matters**" is not related to the idea of sharing information.
